Package it.polimi.ingsw.model.client

Class ClientPlayer

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.client.ClientPlayer
Direct Known Subclasses:
LocalPlayer, RemotePlayer
public abstract class ClientPlayer extends Object
Stores the information about a player's state. The main information is the nickname, the color, the cards placed and the score.
